findings.title: Investigation guard and Qodo checksum ship without tests
findings.description: The new Investigation guard in the `ticket carries its investigation` step, which decides whether the agent may start, and the Qodo installer checksum branch, which decides whether an unverified script may run, are behavior changes with no test in `tests/`. Nothing in the repository runs these shell snippets or checks the regex that matches the `**Investigation.**` or `## Investigation` heading. A later edit to that regex, or to the checksum fallback, could silently let tickets start without an investigation or run an unverified installer, and the test suite would still pass.

findings.title: Pull requests can use the issue token
findings.description: `ticket-link` passes an issue-reading `GITHUB_TOKEN` to a script checked out from the pull request's merge ref. A contributor can replace that script in their PR and use the token to request issue data beyond the titles this check needs.

findings.title: Ticket work can expose the review key
findings.description: The Claude action receives `QODO_API_KEY` for its entire run rather than only for the Qodo review invocation. Tests and product commands that the agent creates or runs while following an issue execute in that environment, so ticket-influenced code can read the key.

findings.title: Commented-out closing keywords pass the check
findings.description: `closingIssueNumbers` applies `CLOSING_REFERENCE` to the raw Markdown body, counting `Closes #20` inside HTML comments, fenced code blocks, and inline code spans. When the issue title and backlog row otherwise match, those references let `ticket-link` pass even though GitHub will not close the issue after merge.

findings.title: Titles naming an earlier ticket stay red
findings.description: `checkPrTicket` treats every T-NNN in the PR title as a ticket the PR finishes, and requires the BACKLOG row for each one to say `done (PR <this number>)`. A title such as `feat(config): custom section names (T-027, split from T-008)`, written the same way as the existing T-027 backlog row, cannot pass unless the author overwrites T-008's history row `done (PR 21)`.

findings.title: Factory script writes to process streams outside src/cli.ts
findings.description: `main` in `scripts/pr-ticket-check.ts` writes to `process.stdout` and `process.stderr` and sets `process.exitCode` directly, instead of returning values for `src/cli.ts` to display. The rule confines these process-level accesses to `src/cli.ts`, and the PR author's note argues that `scripts/` is exempt, but the checklist has no such carve-out. The entry block also sets `process.exitCode`, so any later reuse of `main` from another script or test inherits the stream writes and exit-code mutation.

findings.title: A ticket PR can close the wrong issue
findings.description: `checkPrTicket` accepts any closing keyword followed by an issue number without checking that the issue belongs to a ticket named in the title. A PR for T-008 can therefore pass with `Closes #1` and a matching backlog status even though the repository identifies T-008’s issue as #20; the same gap applies when a title names multiple tickets.

findings.title: An added backlog row can hide stale status
findings.description: `backlogStatuses` silently overwrites an earlier ticket status when it encounters a second row with the same ID. If a PR appends a matching `done (PR <number>)` row without updating the original row, `ticket-link` passes despite the original backlog entry still having the wrong status.

findings.title: A rejected ticket cannot retry as told
findings.description: The Investigation guard fails the labeled-event run but leaves `ready-for-agent` attached while telling the user to add that label again. Editing the issue and attempting to add an already-present label produces no new `labeled` event, so the corrected ticket does not start through the instructed retry path.

findings.title: A review install failure stops ticket work
findings.description: The Qodo setup step handles a failed `whoami` as unavailable, but its download, checksum, installer and version commands have no corresponding fallback. When any of those commands fails with a key configured, the step fails before the implementation agent runs, rather than allowing the pending-gate path used for an unavailable reviewer.

review_agent_comment:
Please make the ticket-link check match GitHub’s closing-keyword behavior: keywords in comments or code should not satisfy it. Also consider titles that mention an earlier ticket without requiring that ticket’s backlog status to be rewritten.

Keep the issue-reading token and Qodo key away from commands or code influenced by untrusted PRs and tickets. If the agent must receive the Qodo key, give it narrow scope. Consider limiting check-run cancellation to pull requests so quick successive merges do not cancel checks for commits on `main`.

Please verify the Qodo installer path and that `whoami` reads the environment key on the first keyed run; otherwise the bot may silently fall back to “gate pending.”
